lines.text: Thought-provoking novel set in an apartment building in Brussels during WWII focusing on the entwined fates of the residents. Told by first person narrators, each with a distinctive voice, viewpoints, and responses to the Nazi regime and antisemitism. Austin explores with compassion, honesty, and a moving plot what people choose to do when faced with evil.
